title: nageia flagelliformis
intro: Nageia flagelliformis, commonly known as the Borneo mistletoe or Borneo nageia, is a species of flowering plant that is endemic to the island of Borneo. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nageia flagelliformis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. Research has also identified the plant's potential in treating various diseases, including diabetes, hypertension, and certain types of cancer.
